about: The autopilot switch, read by .github/workflows/autopilot.yml from main. "off": the gate does nothing. "shadow": the gate comments on each run's pull request and merges nothing; Josh merges by hand. "on": a run's pull request with nothing held merges itself and the site publishes. A run's pull request can never change this file. See docs/listings.md, "The autopilot gate".
